architecture_note: Prompt template assumed gateway/services/workers + MongoDB + NATS/JetStream + @wenex/sdk. Actual repo (LingoSpeak) is a single apps/api (NestJS 11) + apps/web (Next.js 15) npm-workspaces monorepo on PostgreSQL/Prisma, Redis, BullMQ (inline in queue.service.ts), MinIO, ZarinPal. See plan file and AUDIT/00-map.md for the adaptation table. Note: this machine also has an unrelated, already-running docker stack (wenex/*, platform-*, mongodb-primary, nats, kafka, etc.) matching the ORIGINAL prompt's assumed architecture almost exactly -- strong evidence the prompt was written for that other project. Not touched by this audit; local test stack ran on remapped ports (15432/16379/19000-19001) under docker-compose project name lingospeak-audit.

findings.regression_test: same as RATE-003 (duplicate finding, same fix)

Unused dependencies (apps/web radix/cva/clsx/tailwind-merge/zod, apps/api bcryptjs)

findings.title: app.module.ts reads process.env.JWT_ACCESS_SECRET directly
x-request-id response header reflects unvalidated client-supplied value
DiscountDto.value has no upper bound; type not enum-restricted
No abuse-velocity/progressive-penalty controls on money-adjacent admin actions

findings.title: GET /teachers throughput ceiling flat across 20x concurrency range; excess load queues instead of shedding
findings.note: architecture/capacity observation (dev-mode measurement, single Node process, no clustering), not a targeted code bug -- documented for follow-up capacity planning

findings.title: Genuinely simultaneous duplicate ZarinPal callbacks can get a transient 409 instead of an idempotent 200
findings.note: minor robustness gap found via load testing, not code reading; no double-grant occurs. Touches the money-flow transaction so flagged rather than fixed inline per the hard rule; safe direction is a retry-once-on-P2034 inside callback()
